mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 270.0 (CPIAUCSL > 270.0) indicates persistent inflation, prompting delayed Fed rate cuts and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 270.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) and retail sales (RSAFS < 600000) signal broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Fed maintains accommodative policy to support labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 145000) signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 145000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic weakness and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 < 19300) combined with declining housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signals severe demand shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession fears mount.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 < 19300 and HOUST < 1500 fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 40% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing expansion regimes (INDPRO > 102.0), strong industrial output supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
